MAINT-TIMEOUT-S1.title: Define Timeout UX State Schema and Contract
MAINT-TIMEOUT-S1.description: Define frontend state model for long-running request handling including timeout threshold, modal visibility, user decision (continue/abandon), and request lifecycle states (pending, timed_out, resumed, cancelled).

MAINT-TIMEOUT-S2.title: Implement Timeout Detection and Control Logic
MAINT-TIMEOUT-S2.description: Implement core logic using timers and AbortController to detect long-running requests (~45s), trigger timeout state, pause UI updates, and support continuation or cancellation paths.

MAINT-TIMEOUT-S3.title: Render Timeout Modal with Continue/Abandon UX
MAINT-TIMEOUT-S3.description: Build and refine modal UI that appears on timeout, providing clear options to continue waiting or abandon the request, with appropriate messaging and accessibility considerations.

MAINT-TIMEOUT-S4.title: Integrate Timeout Handling with Chat Request Flow
MAINT-TIMEOUT-S4.description: Integrate timeout logic into end-to-end chat flow ensuring resumed requests continue correctly, cancelled requests clean up state, and no duplicate or orphaned responses occur.

MAINT-TIMEOUT-S5.title: Unit and Interaction Tests for Timeout UX
MAINT-TIMEOUT-S5.description: Create tests covering timeout trigger timing, modal display, continue/abandon actions, AbortController behavior, and prevention of duplicate responses after resume.
